core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fiza corresponds to the Arabic form فِضا (Arabic root ف ض و (f-ḍ-w) / ف ي ض (f-y-ḍ)). Its core sense is open expanse; spaciousness. Fiza is a popular South Asian female name. Its usual form فِضا relates to Arabic فضى 'open expanse, spaciousness' (hence 'openness, freedom'), though it is also popularly associated with the Persianate word for breeze/atmosphere. The source gloss 'blooming, radiant' is unsupported; the source also gave فيضة as the Arabic form, which belongs to Feyza, not Fiza.
